item.nusmp.magnas_soul_bat.lore: A flame-studded club. Magna Swing casts through it: the spell is a ball tossed ahead, the swing sends it.
item.nusmp.magnas_soul_bat.use: Hold it in the main hand to cast the Fire pages of Magna's grimoire.
nusmp.firecast.spent: The spiral stops winding: no mana left.
nusmp.firecast.ready: Ready: the page. Punch to release it.
nusmp.firecast.spirit.full: The Salamander cannot answer: too many spirits are out.
nusmp.firecast.spirit.unlinked: The Salamander returns to its flames.
